mission: R2C-HERO60 P0.1C — Durable VFX Lab State Restore

restoreMechanism.description: DEV-only RESTORE QA CHECKPOINT buttons added to the VFX Lab Workbench. Two buttons: (1) RESTORE P0.1B CHECKPOINT — loads the bundled P0.1B checkpoint JSON directly, (2) RESTORE FROM FILE — opens a file picker to load any checkpoint JSON. Both call restoreLabStateFromCheckpoint() which validates the schema, extracts LabState, and persists through the normal saveLabStateToStorage(localStorage) path. The Inspector updates immediately after restore. No auto-overwrite on startup — restore is explicit and intentional only.
functions: restoreLabStateFromCheckpoint(raw: string): LabCheckpointRestoreResult — validates and restores LabState from JSON string
validateCheckpointLabState(raw: unknown): boolean — schema validation for LabState fields
uiButtons: RESTORE FROM FILE... — opens file picker for any checkpoint JSON
